title: Amazing App
body:
Feeling very productive and proud of myself for keeping track of goals. I love the user interface of the app and the sound for reminders.
One improvement I would like to see in the milestones card is to have my completed items show with my incomplete tasks. I know I can click in to view completed milestones but would be great to see them without having to click into it.
author: Suretobejaysus

title: Great App
body: Great app, but keeps crashing since Nov 1st update...
author: JohnDil

title: Solid
body: Nice app and intuitive to use. I like the separate skins for each habit and the interaction with Apple's health app is nifty. I'm tracking weight through the app and the only issue I have is that the chart line tracking the weight is not customisable so that progress is not displayed very well as small changes are barely visible. That not very motivating. Other than that, it's better than most that I've tried!
author: K4tty
